name: Try3: 400 diverse eighteen-metre missions with test7 stage3

selection.candidate_sampling: Enumerate feasible ordered cell pairs; random bearing within the corner-defined angular span; uniform start inside source/shifted-goal rectangle intersection; goal=start+18m unit bearing
selection.balancing: Fill regular, stairs, ice, multiple_choices in this order, then greedy cell coverage and category/cell diversity with seeded random tie breaks; repeated cell pairs penalized
selection.geometric_category_rules: Same as try1; multiple_choices has priority when >=5 cells and >=4 terrain types
selection.initial_yaw: Independent uniform [-pi, pi), fixed in mission file
selection.reference_note: Frozen snapshot of all 32 selected episodes, including tentative cases; later collection edits do not change this panel

path_note: Geometric diversity constraints describe assigned segments, not predicted policy outcomes. All 400 outcomes must be retained.
